title: How BAD is the $140 Carpet from Amazon? Car Interior Replacement
description:
The RX-7 is ratty.  I looked for any replacement carpet for the car.  I didn't want the cheapest option, i wanted any option.  Sadly its got some serious issues.  After purchasing i did find that the company has some choices that aren't present on Amazon.  Ill contact them and see if they can improve on all the horrible issues i found.
